description: Look up how long a maker's own warranty runs for a brand of home appliance in the United States or the United Kingdom, with the maker's page as the source, and whether the maker asks for registration and by when. Use it when someone asks how long a warranty lasts or whether to register a product. It takes a brand, a country and optionally a category; it does not take or need any purchase details. The brand list also holds names a smart home hub gives, such as "Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.". To give an end date, add the years to the person's purchase date. When the answer has "known": false, FrogCog has no sourced length for that maker in that country: say so, without estimating one.

brand.description: The maker's brand name, or the company name a smart home hub gives for it.

category.description: Only where the maker gives this category its own warranty length.

country.description: US for the United States, GB for the United Kingdom.

name: warranty_terms
title: Maker's warranty for a brand
